nodes.name: Animation
nodes.description: The art of creating the illusion of motion through sequences of images or posed objects.

nodes.name: 2D Animation
nodes.description: Animation drawn or composited on a two-dimensional plane.

nodes.name: Traditional Animation
nodes.description: Hand-drawn animation in which each frame is drawn on paper or cels.

nodes.name: Cel Animation
nodes.description: Traditional animation painting characters on transparent celluloid sheets over backgrounds.

nodes.name: Full Animation
nodes.description: Smooth animation drawing on every frame at high frame rates.

nodes.name: Limited Animation
nodes.description: Economical animation reusing drawings and holding frames, pioneered for television.

nodes.name: Cutout Animation
nodes.description: Animation moving flat cut-out pieces, whether paper or digital rigs.

nodes.name: Rotoscoping
nodes.description: Animation traced frame by frame over live-action footage.

nodes.name: 3D Animation
nodes.description: Computer animation of objects modeled and moved in three-dimensional space.

nodes.name: Computer Animation
nodes.description: Animation generated and rendered by computer software.

nodes.name: Computer-Generated Imagery
nodes.description: Images created entirely with computer graphics, spanning stills and motion.

nodes.name: Motion Capture
nodes.description: Recording live movement to drive digital characters.

nodes.name: Stop Motion
nodes.description: Animation by photographing physically manipulated objects frame by frame.

nodes.name: Claymation
nodes.description: Stop motion using malleable clay figures.

nodes.name: Puppet Animation
nodes.description: Stop motion using articulated puppet figures.

nodes.name: Object Animation
nodes.description: Stop motion animating everyday or found objects.

nodes.name: Pixilation
nodes.description: Stop motion using live actors as frame-by-frame puppets.

nodes.name: Motion Graphics
nodes.description: Animated graphic design, typography, and abstract imagery.

nodes.name: Experimental Animation
nodes.description: Avant-garde animation exploring non-narrative, abstract, and material techniques.

nodes.name: Sand Animation
nodes.description: Animation manipulating sand on a lit surface.

nodes.name: Paint-on-Glass Animation
nodes.description: Animation painting directly on glass and photographing each stroke.

nodes.name: Pinscreen Animation
nodes.description: Animation using a screen of pins to create relief images.

nodes.name: Anime
nodes.description: Japanese animation spanning television, film, and OVA formats.

nodes.name: Shonen Anime
nodes.description: Anime aimed at young male audiences, emphasizing action and friendship.

nodes.name: Shojo Anime
nodes.description: Anime aimed at young female audiences, emphasizing romance and emotion.

nodes.name: Seinen Anime
nodes.description: Anime for adult male audiences with mature themes.

nodes.name: Mecha Anime
nodes.description: Anime featuring piloted robots and machines.

nodes.name: Magical Girl Anime
nodes.description: Anime of girls with magical powers and transformations.

nodes.name: Isekai Anime
nodes.description: Anime of protagonists transported to another world.

nodes.name: Slice-of-Life Anime
nodes.description: Anime depicting everyday life without melodramatic conflict.

nodes.name: Visual Effects
nodes.description: The creation or manipulation of imagery not achievable in live action.

nodes.name: Compositing
nodes.description: Combining multiple image layers into a seamless final frame.

nodes.name: Matte Painting
nodes.description: Painted or digital backgrounds extending sets beyond what was filmed.

nodes.name: Practical Effects
nodes.description: Physical effects achieved on set, such as models, prosthetics, and pyrotechnics.

nodes.name: Virtual Production
nodes.description: Film and animation workflow combining real-time CGI with live-action capture.

nodes.name: LED Volume
nodes.description: Large LED walls displaying real-time environments behind actors.

nodes.name: Real-Time Rendering
nodes.description: Rendering imagery instantly using game engines for production.

nodes.name: Character Animation
nodes.description: Bringing characters to life through performance, posing, and timing.

nodes.name: Effects Animation
nodes.description: Animating non-character elements such as water, fire, and magic.

nodes.name: Animated Feature Film
nodes.description: Feature-length animation, whether hand-drawn, CGI, or stop motion.

nodes.name: Adult Animation
nodes.description: Animation created for mature audiences with adult themes.
